title: Social Evolution of Published Text and The Emergence of Artificial Intelligence Through Large Language Models and The Problem of Toxicity and Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating cosine similarity between gendered input words (e.g., 'man', 'woman', 'he', 'she') and various profession words (e.g., 'manager', 'nurse', 'doctor') using word embeddings like GloVe, SpaCy, and FastText.

Measuring cosine similarity associations between religion-related terms (e.g., 'Islam', 'Christianity', 'Judaism') and negative or stereotypical target words (e.g., 'terrorist', 'violent', 'uneducated') using word embeddings, as well as reporting toxicity prediction scores for sentences about different religious practitioners.

Calculating correlation and cosine similarity scores between race/nationality-related terms (e.g., 'black', 'caucasian', 'asian', 'african', 'white') and target attributes or roles (e.g., 'slave', 'criminal', 'farmer', 'executive') across different word embedding models.
